thread:
sara-support: FYI — customer reported sudden 401s when calling /v1/completions. They pasted a GitHub Gist link with the key file and I think the client ended up sending the JSON blob as the token. Repro below.

miguel-support: can you paste the raw request header we saw?

sara-support: here's the curl they ran (redacted):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {"apiKey":"sk_live_ABC123...","created_at":"2025-11-01"}' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-mini","prompt":"hi"}'
```

sara-support: Response: 401 {"error":{"code":"invalid_api_key","message":"Invalid API key."}}

eng-oncall: ouch. so their client is literally sending the whole JSON from the Gist as the bearer token. that explains the 401. did they rotate/expire the real key?

sara-support: they checked the console — the key in their Gist matches an older key id and is active. but when i asked them to paste the raw header from browser devtools, it showed the JSON blob. they said they copied the file from a public gist and assumed the one-line string was the file.

miguel-support: can we reproduce locally quickly? try pasting a fake JSON as token to confirm we get same error. also capture the request id if available.

sara-support: repro locally: same 401. request-id: req_0a7f3b (from response header).

infra-bot: Incident note: support-ticket-4281 auto-escalated to infra-team for "invalid_api_key" pattern detection (rule matched: token contains '{').

miguel-support: thanks. root cause is malformed token (JSON blob). short-term fix: ask customer to copy the string value only (sk_live_...). longer term: we should detect obvious mistakes and return a hint for common paste errors (e.g., "it looks like you pasted a JSON file; try copying the value inside \"apiKey\"").

product-ops: be careful with telling clients too much in 401 body — we don't want to leak whether key exists/active. but we can add client-side validation in SDKs and a non-sensitive hint when token clearly looks like JSON. product will prioritize a small UX improvement.

miguel-support: for the customer: steps to fix -> 1) open the Gist file, 2) copy the value between the quotes after apiKey, 3) replace Authorization header with `Bearer sk_live_...`, 4) retry. sent sample curl back.

sara-support: customer confirmed fix worked after we told them to copy just the sk token. they rotated the key anyway for hygiene.

miguel-support: created ENG ticket INF-1729 to add server-side detection for common paste artifacts and an SDK lint rule. tagging eng-runtime.

eng-oncall: adding note for logs: capture token length and presence of non-token chars ("{", "}", '"', ':') in a redacted way to help support triage without storing secrets.

sara-support: closing the loop with customer now. marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
